note: This verifies sequential/default and parallel runner accounting, execution/rejection paths and manifest integrity checks using locally encoded fixtures. It is not an official ACT4 suite result. --jobs 2 preserves all four mixed outcomes and logs.
fixture_construction: run_act4.minimal_elf(0x1000fff0); FAIL replaces instruction word 2 with 0x00200113; TIMEOUT replaces it with 0x00000113; oversize sets PT_LOAD p_memsz to 65537. Full ELF bytes are retained below.
